title: Modern 3BR Apartment in Tel Aviv
description: Bright 3-bedroom apartment on the 5th floor with a large balcony overlooking the city. Renovated kitchen with granite countertops, two full bathrooms, and a covered parking spot. Located 10 minutes from the beach and close to public transport.

title: Renovated 2BR Near the Sea in Herzliya
description: Fully renovated 2-bedroom apartment 200 meters from the beach. New flooring throughout, modern open-plan kitchen, and a sunny balcony. Building has an elevator and storage room. Ideal for couples or small families.

title: Spacious Family Home with Garden in Ra'anana
description: 4-bedroom detached house with a 300 sqm private garden and double garage. Large living room with high ceilings, fully equipped kitchen, and a master bedroom with en-suite bathroom. Quiet residential street, close to schools and parks.

title: Luxury Penthouse with Sea View in Netanya
description: Stunning penthouse apartment on the 18th floor with panoramic sea views. 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, private rooftop terrace, and two parking spaces. Floor-to-ceiling windows, designer kitchen, and smart home system throughout.

title: Studio Apartment in Central Jerusalem
description: Compact and well-maintained studio apartment in the heart of Jerusalem. Open-plan living and sleeping area, kitchenette, and a full bathroom. Walking distance to the Old City, restaurants, and public transport. Suitable for students or young professionals.

title: Commercial Office Space in Tel Aviv Business District
description: 200 sqm open-plan office space on the 8th floor of a Class A office building. Includes 4 private meeting rooms, kitchenette, and 3 parking spaces. 24/7 security, reception service, and fiber internet infrastructure. Ideal for tech or finance companies.

title: Retail Shop with Street Frontage in Haifa
description: 80 sqm ground-floor retail unit on a busy commercial street in central Haifa. Large display windows, high foot traffic, storage room at the back, and a staff bathroom. Previously used as a clothing boutique. Available for immediate occupation.

title: 4BR Villa with Pool in Herzliya Pituach
description: Elegant 4-bedroom villa in the prestigious Herzliya Pituach neighborhood. Private swimming pool, landscaped garden, and a double garage. Open kitchen connected to a large dining area, guest bedroom with en-suite, and a home office. Walking distance to the beach.

title: New Construction 3BR in Beer Sheva
description: Brand new 3-bedroom apartment in a newly completed building in Beer Sheva. Never lived in. Modern finishes throughout, built-in wardrobes, solar water heater, and a covered parking space. Close to Ben-Gurion University and major shopping centers.

title: Ground Floor Apartment with Private Garden in Rehovot
description: Accessible ground floor 3-bedroom apartment with a 60 sqm private garden. No stairs, suitable for elderly or mobility-impaired residents. Renovated bathroom, spacious living room, and a quiet location on a tree-lined street. Close to Weizmann Institute.

title: Industrial Warehouse in Petah Tikva
description: 1,200 sqm industrial warehouse with 6-meter ceiling height, loading dock, and heavy-duty electric supply. Office mezzanine of 80 sqm included. Secured compound with 24-hour guard, 10 parking spaces, and direct access to the main highway.

title: Charming 2BR Cottage in Zichron Yaakov
description: Renovated stone cottage with 2 bedrooms, exposed wooden beams, and a fireplace. Surrounded by a lush garden with fruit trees. Separate guest studio, outdoor dining area, and stunning Carmel mountain views. Perfect as a holiday home or permanent residence.

title: 5BR Family Villa in Savyon
description: Prestigious 5-bedroom villa in the exclusive Savyon neighborhood. 600 sqm living space on a 1,200 sqm plot. Heated swimming pool, wine cellar, home cinema, and a triple garage. High-end finishes throughout, gated community with landscaped common areas.

title: 1BR Apartment Near Dizengoff Center in Tel Aviv
description: Well-maintained 1-bedroom apartment on the 3rd floor of a quiet building near Dizengoff Center. Fully furnished option available. Air conditioning throughout, small balcony, and a renovated bathroom. Walking distance to cafes, restaurants, and the beach.

title: Office Floor in Ramat Gan Diamond Exchange
description: 350 sqm full floor office in the Diamond Exchange district of Ramat Gan. Divided into 8 private offices, conference room, reception, and kitchenette. Underground parking for 4 cars, prestigious address, and proximity to Ayalon Highway.

title: 3BR Apartment with Sea View in Ashdod
description: Bright 3-bedroom apartment on the 10th floor with unobstructed sea views. Master bedroom with en-suite, open kitchen with island, large living room, and a wraparound balcony. Two parking spaces, storage room, and building gym included.

title: Townhouse in Modi'in
description: Modern 4-bedroom townhouse in a sought-after Modi'in neighborhood. Three levels, private entrance, rooftop terrace with barbecue area, and a small front garden. Energy-efficient construction with solar panels, electric vehicle charging point, and smart home features.

title: Restaurant Space in Jaffa Port Area
description: 120 sqm commercial space in the vibrant Jaffa Port area. Previously operated as a restaurant with full kitchen infrastructure in place. High ceilings, exposed stone walls, outdoor seating area for 30 covers, and strong tourist foot traffic year-round.

title: 2BR Apartment in Eilat with Pool Access
description: Holiday apartment in a gated complex in Eilat. 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a large terrace with Red Sea views. Complex includes a swimming pool, gym, and 24-hour security. Fully furnished and generating rental income. Ideal investment property.

title: Affordable 3BR in Afula City Center
description: Spacious 3-bedroom apartment in central Afula. Recently painted, parquet flooring, large storage room, and a sunny balcony. Close to market, schools, and public transport. Parking available in the building. Suitable for families looking for value.
